series: Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, Reason #24 (reading about it)
hook: Reading about your goal feels like doing it. It isn't.

gate.goal_link: any creative/skill goal (book, running, a channel) where preparation replaces output
gate.mechanism: consuming information about a goal is low effort and feels on-topic, so it satisfies the urge to make progress without producing anything (motion vs action); the gap shows up weeks later and the goal is dropped. No study cited.
gate.universal: watching videos / buying books about a goal instead of doing it

frame.obstacle: learning about writing feels like working on it
frame.fix: make first, learn second: 100 words then one video; 15-min run then read about form; learn only what today's step needs. 100 words x 6 weeks ~ 4,000 words (arithmetic)
